review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: There is an opinion that school should rewards students who contribute and gain many academic achievements, while others progressive students should be received from education. Personally, I belive that both student groups need reward because of their progressive.

Admittedly, school should recognizing students who has the best academic result. Because students have diligently applied themselves to their studies, they deserve their praises and privileges. Furthermore, This may encourage those students and others to study harder to win the rewards, leading to propel towards overall academic gains. Additionally, this kind of competition has been seen in almost every aspect of life where only the best individuals are rewarded; students are used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce, they are enable them to achieve success in later life.

However, students is improve changes themself and become good result, school should reward their. If only a few smart student can come first and receive the reward, this cause others to think that their effort is futile. Because they can not surpass those outstanding individuals, they are prone to feeling overwhelmed and disheartened and gradually lose the incentive to study. Moreover, emphasizing improvements which will encourage all students to be diligent in their studies and help students to understand that they need to constantly improve themselves; as a result, this is irrespective of how well they have been or are performing, the constant desire to outdo themselves and even benefit themselves more than the competitive determination to win against all other.
In conclusion, I firmly convinced that school or society should reward students who gain the best achievements or is more effort to improve their characteristics.

completion.comment: Bài có mở bài, hai thân bài và kết luận trên nguồn ảnh đủ trang.

review.overall: Em đã viết đủ mở bài, hai thân bài và kết luận, đồng thời cố trình bày cả thành tích lẫn tiến bộ. Tuy nhiên, mức vận dụng trong bài này rất yếu: mở bài có 'school should rewards' và 'students should be received from education'; Body 1 có 'school should recognizing' và câu 'they are enable them'; Body 2 chắp nhiều mệnh đề khiến cơ chế nản chí rồi tự cải thiện khó theo. Đây là lỗi nền tảng xuất hiện dày, nên bài còn cẩu thả ở khâu dựng câu và tự soát. Em cần viết lại từng đoạn, xác định chủ ngữ–động từ trước, sau đó mới nối các bước của dàn ý. Cô không chấm riêng chữ chồng ở đầu Body 2 khi nét chưa đủ chắc. Body 1 thiếu mốc lý do công sức, rồi đặt “Furthermore” trước hệ quả khuyến khích vẫn thuộc lý do ấy; “Additionally” sau đó mới thực sự mở lý do cạnh tranh. Body 2 có “Moreover” đúng cho lợi ích tiến bộ nhưng “If” chưa báo rõ lý do đầu.

task.text:
Some people think that school should reward students who show the best academic results, while others believe that it is more important to reward students who show improvements.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
